prompt: What really caused the 2008 financial crisis? Tell it as a story starting from the US housing boom, include subprime mortgages, securitization, Lehman Brothers and the government response.

plan.title: What Really Caused the 2008 Financial Crisis
plan.description: A fast story of the 2008 financial crisis, from the US housing boom and subprime mortgages to securitization, Lehman Brothers and the government response.

beats.narration: Banks handed home loans to people who couldn't repay them. Then they packaged those risky loans and sold them worldwide.

props.text: Risky loans, sold to the whole world

beats.narration: Subprime mortgages fed the housing boom. Securitization spread the risk everywhere. When home prices fell, borrowers defaulted, and Lehman Brothers collapsed.
Panic froze credit, so governments bailed out banks. The lesson: when everyone shares hidden risk, one failure can shake the world.

props.text: Hidden risk, shared by everyone, breaks everyone
